name: Cryogenic OGS Ltd
tagline: Rs ~530 Cr BSE-SME maker of cryogenic and flow / measurement equipment for oil & gas, LNG and industrial gases -- ROCE ~29%, debt-free, ADNOC/EIL empanelled, 4x capacity expansion plus railway & defence diversification -- but a ~Rs 40 Cr revenue base at ~13x sales
business_overview: Cryogenic OGS (BSE SME: 544440) designs and builds cryogenic storage / transfer systems, loading arms, flow-measurement and metering skids and allied engineered equipment for oil & gas, LNG, city-gas and industrial-gas customers, with stated empanelment with ADNOC and Engineers India (EIL) and a diversification push into railway and defence applications.
fundamentals_table: ~13x sales; rich single-digit-hundreds Cr mcap on ~Rs 40 Cr revenue
fundamentals_narrative: Return ratios are strong and the balance sheet is clean, and cryogenic / LNG-handling equipment sits on a real multi-year infrastructure theme (city-gas, LNG terminals, industrial gases, and the newly-added upstream oilfield-services demand vector). ADNOC / EIL empanelment is a modest barrier to entry. But revenue is only ~Rs 40 Cr, so the ~Rs 530 Cr mcap capitalises a very small business at ~13x sales, and the 4x capacity expansion plus railway / defence diversification is optionality that is entirely unproven in the P&L. Order-book and execution disclosure is thin.

verdict_headline: Clean, high-ROCE niche cryo-equipment maker on a real theme, but ~13x sales on a ~Rs 40 Cr base with unproven expansion -- 'neither', conviction Low-Medium
verdict_reasoning: Directional theme relevance -- 'oilfield services / drilling & exploration capex' (priority-2, added 2026-09-09) and LNG / city-gas infra -- but processed as an external lead, not a discovery theme hit; the exposure is to LNG / industrial-gas handling rather than upstream drilling per se.

four_box score 1.5 -> 'neither' (hard). tailwind weak (real LNG / industrial-gas infra pull but not sharply accelerating for this niche), tam weak (small engineered-equipment niche, ~Rs 530 Cr mcap already), moat weak (ADNOC / EIL pre-qualification is a modest barrier; otherwise lumpy job-shop), valuation no (~13x sales on ~Rs 40 Cr revenue). The 4x-capacity catalyst is noted as unconfirmed and does not lift a 1.5 score.

Conviction Low-Medium: a notch above Low for the debt-free balance sheet, ~29% ROCE, pre-qualifications and a concrete capacity catalyst; capped by valuation, size, order-book opacity and the untrusted source. Re-check once expanded capacity and any railway / defence orders show up in reported revenue.
